messages.subject: Mean AKDES and PKDES
parts:
Hello, 

My team has been using CTMM web to complete the individual AKDEs to estimate home ranges, but are now looking to find either the mean AKDE or PKDE. This is possible using R, but it seems like this is not a feature of CTMM web.

Thanks!

ctmmweb is maintained but we aren't new adding features to it.

the ctmm MoveApps are getting new features (https://www.moveapps.org/) . I know that PKDE is already on MoveApps.

Best,
Chris
